```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

```{r setup}
library(gambitR)
```

## A position

Every workflow starts from a `gm_position`. The default is the standard
starting position.

```{r}
pos <- gm_position()
pos
```

## Legal moves

```{r}
gm_legal_moves(pos)
```

## Playing and simulating

Pit two strategies against each other, or run a batch tournament.

```{r eval = FALSE}
game <- gm_play(white = "engine", black = "random")
gm_simulate(white = "random", black = "random", n = 20)
```

## Analysis

Static evaluation and engine search drive the analysis tools.

```{r}
gm_evaluate(pos)
```

See the other articles for the opening explorer, puzzle trainer, and the
interactive Shiny application launched with `gm_run_app()`.
